import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class BitSet128 {
        long[] bits = new long[2];

        public BitSet128() {
            bits[0] = 0L;
            bits[1] = 0L;
        }

        public void set(int index, boolean value) {
            if (index < 64) {
                if (value) bits[0] |= 1L << index;
                else bits[0] &= ~(1L << index);
            } else {
                int idx = index - 64;
                if (value) bits[1] |= 1L << idx;
                else bits[1] &= ~(1L << idx);
            }
        }

        public boolean get(int index) {
            if (index < 64) {
                return ((bits[0] >>> index) & 1L) != 0;
            } else {
                int idx = index - 64;
                return ((bits[1] >>> idx) & 1L) != 0;
            }
        }

        public BitSet128 copy() {
            BitSet128 b = new BitSet128();
            b.bits[0] = this.bits[0];
            b.bits[1] = this.bits[1];
            return b;
        }

        public void or(BitSet128 other) {
            this.bits[0] |= other.bits[0];
            this.bits[1] |= other.bits[1];
        }

        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (!(o instanceof BitSet128)) return false;
            BitSet128 b = (BitSet128) o;
            return bits[0] == b.bits[0] && bits[1] == b.bits[1];
        }

        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(bits[0], bits[1]);
        }

        public boolean getBit(int index) {
            return get(index);
        }
    }

    static class Mint {
        static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
        long v;

        public Mint() {
            this.v = 0;
        }

        public Mint(long v) {
            this.v = normS(v % MOD);
        }

        private static long normS(long x) {
            return x < 0 ? x + MOD : x;
        }

        public Mint add(Mint b) {
            return new Mint(normS(this.v + b.v));
        }

        public Mint subtract(Mint b) {
            return new Mint(normS(this.v - b.v));
        }

        public Mint multiply(Mint b) {
            return new Mint((this.v * b.v) % MOD);
        }

        public Mint inv() {
            long[] gcdResult = extgcd(this.v, MOD);
            long x = gcdResult[1];
            return new Mint(normS(x));
        }

        public Mint divide(Mint b) {
            return this.multiply(b.inv());
        }

        private long[] extgcd(long a, long b) {
            long x0 = 1, y0 = 0;
            long x1 = 0, y1 = 1;
            while (b != 0) {
                long q = a / b;
                long r = a % b;
                long xTemp = x0 - q * x1;
                long yTemp = y0 - q * y1;
                a = b;
                b = r;
                x0 = x1;
                y0 = y1;
                x1 = xTemp;
                y1 = yTemp;
            }
            return new long[]{a, x0, y0};
        }

        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (!(o instanceof Mint)) return false;
            Mint m = (Mint) o;
            return v == m.v;
        }

        public int hashCode() {
            return Long.hashCode(v);
        }

        public String toString() {
            return Long.toString(v);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        int N = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        Mint[][] p = new Mint[N][N];

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                p[i][j] = new Mint(Long.parseLong(st.nextToken()));
                p[i][j] = p[i][j].divide(new Mint(100));
            }
        }

        Map<BitSet128, Mint> current = new HashMap<>();
        Map<BitSet128, Mint> next = new HashMap<>();

        BitSet128 b = new BitSet128();
        b.set(0, true);
        current.put(b, new Mint(1));

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            next.clear();
            for (Map.Entry<BitSet128, Mint> entry : current.entrySet()) {
                BitSet128 bitset = entry.getKey();
                Mint prob = entry.getValue();

                List<Integer> ones = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int idx = 0; idx < (1 << N); idx++) {
                    if (bitset.get(idx)) {
                        ones.add(idx);
                    }
                }

                for (int e = 0; e < (1 << N); e++) {
                    Mint pr = new Mint(1);
                    for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                        if (((e >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                            pr = pr.multiply(p[i][j]);
                        } else {
                            pr = pr.multiply(new Mint(1).subtract(p[i][j]));
                        }
                    }
                    BitSet128 nb = new BitSet128();
                    for (int x : ones) {
                        for (int r = 0; r < N; r++) {
                            if (((e >> r) & 1) == 1 && !bitset.get(r)) {
                                BitSet128 temp = new BitSet128();
                                temp.set(x, true);
                                temp.set(r, true);
                                nb.or(temp);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    next.put(nb, next.getOrDefault(nb, new Mint(0)).add(prob.multiply(pr)));
                }
            }
            current = new HashMap<>(next);
        }

        Mint answer = new Mint(0);
        for (Map.Entry<BitSet128, Mint> entry : current.entrySet()) {
            BitSet128 bitset = entry.getKey();
            if (bitset.get((1 << N) - 1)) {
                answer = answer.add(entry.getValue());
            }
        }

        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
